'''Esteren Higgs''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' at the time of its crash on the crystalline world of [[Isis/Legends|Isis]]. The [[Engine/Legends|engine]] room took a direct hit during a battle with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] over Isis, and Higgs was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and his body was badly burned.
